steps: 1. Decompose: Split the irregular shape into basic figures (rectangles, triangles, trapezoids)

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Flooring
revealWordProblem.text:
A garden designer wants to cover a gazebo floor with tiles. The gazebo floor is a regular decagon with equal sides, shown here with a side of 3¾ feet and a distance of 5¾ feet from the center to the middle of a side.
Question: If floor tiles cost $2.89 per square foot, what budget do you recommend the designer have for the tiles?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A regular decagon gazebo floor labeled 3 and three-fourths feet on one side and 5 and three-fourths feet from the center to the middle of a side.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Decompose the decagon into 10 identical triangles that meet at the center. Each triangle has a base of 3¾ = 3.75 feet and a height of 5¾ = 5.75 feet, so its area is ½ × 3.75 × 5.75 = 10.78125 square feet. Ten triangles give 107.8125 square feet. At $2.89 per square foot, the tile cost is 107.8125 × 2.89 ≈ $311.58. I would recommend a budget of about $320 so there is room for a few extra tiles for cuts and breakage.

questions.stem: An L-shaped room is made of two rectangles: 10 ft × 6 ft and 4 ft × 3 ft. What is the total area?
questions.explanation: Area 1 = 10 × 6 = 60 sq ft. Area 2 = 4 × 3 = 12 sq ft. Total = 60 + 12 = 72 sq ft.
hints: The L-shape is already split into two rectangles for you: 10 × 6 and 4 × 3.
Find each rectangle's area separately with A = l × w, then combine — joined shapes mean adding.
Compute 10 × 6 and 4 × 3, then add the two results. Label your answer in sq ft.
questions.stemEs: Una habitación en forma de L está formada por dos rectángulos: 10 ft × 6 ft y 4 ft × 3 ft. ¿Cuál es el área total?
questions.explanationEs: Área 1 = 10 × 6 = 60 sq ft. Área 2 = 4 × 3 = 12 sq ft. Total = 60 + 12 = 72 sq ft.
hintsEs: La figura en L ya está dividida en dos rectángulos por ti: 10 × 6 y 4 × 3.
Halla el área de cada rectángulo por separado con A = l × a y luego combínalas: figuras unidas significan sumar.
Calcula 10 × 6 y 4 × 3, y luego suma los dos resultados. Etiqueta tu respuesta en pies².

questions.stem: A rectangular patio is 15 ft × 10 ft with a 5 ft × 4 ft rectangular flower bed cut out. What is the remaining area?
questions.explanation: Patio = 15 × 10 = 150 sq ft. Cutout = 5 × 4 = 20 sq ft. Remaining = 150 − 20 = 130 sq ft.
choiceFeedback: A thin rectangle and a square can differ.
hints: The flower bed is CUT OUT of the patio — that phrase tells you which operation to use.
Find the full patio area (15 × 10) and the cutout area (5 × 4), then remove the cutout.
Compute 15 × 10 and 5 × 4, then subtract the flower bed's area from the patio's area.
questions.stemEs: Un patio rectangular mide 15 ft × 10 ft y tiene recortado un jardín rectangular de 5 ft × 4 ft. ¿Cuál es el área restante?
questions.explanationEs: Patio = 15 × 10 = 150 sq ft. Recorte = 5 × 4 = 20 sq ft. Área restante = 150 − 20 = 130 sq ft.
hintsEs: El jardín está RECORTADO del patio: esa frase te dice qué operación usar.
Halla el área total del patio (15 × 10) y el área del recorte (5 × 4), y luego quita el recorte.
Calcula 15 × 10 y 5 × 4, y luego resta el área del jardín del área del patio.

questions.stem: Find the area of an L-shape made of a 5×3 rectangle and a 2×4 rectangle.
choiceFeedback: A thin shape can have big perimeter, small area.
Area and perimeter are not linked.
You must use both to describe a shape.
hints: Two rectangles make this L: one is 5 × 3 and the other is 2 × 4.
Joined pieces mean you add their areas after computing each one with length × width.
Find 5 × 3, then 2 × 4, and add the two products together.
questions.stemEs: Halla el área de una figura en forma de L formada por un rectángulo de 5×3 y uno de 2×4.
hintsEs: Dos rectángulos forman esta L: uno es 5 × 3 y el otro es 2 × 4.
Las piezas unidas significan que sumas sus áreas después de calcular cada una con largo × ancho.
Halla 5 × 3, luego 2 × 4, y suma los dos productos.

steps: 1. Decompose: Split the irregular shape into basic figures (rectangles, triangles, trapezoids)
2. Calculate: Find the area of each individual sub-figure
3. Combine: Add the areas together (or subtract if a piece is removed/cut out)
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Area of Composite Figures is adding every piece even when a piece has been cut out of the figure. For a 10 ft by 8 ft rectangle with a 3 ft by 2 ft rectangular notch cut from one corner, students compute the full rectangle 10 × 8 = 80 sq ft and stop, or they add the notch instead of removing it (80 + 6 = 86 sq ft) instead of subtracting it: 80 − (3 × 2) = 80 − 6 = 74 sq ft. Before submitting, check whether each piece is part of the figure (add it) or missing from the figure (subtract it).

level1.stem: A shape is made of a 6 m by 3 m rectangle joined to a 2 m by 5 m rectangle. Find its total area.
level1.stemEs: Una figura está formada por un rectángulo de 6 m por 3 m unido a un rectángulo de 2 m por 5 m. Halla su área total.
hints: Find each rectangle. They are joined, so add.
hintsEs: Halla cada rectángulo. Están unidos, así que suma.
level1.explanation: Find the area of each rectangle: 6 × 3 = 18; 2 × 5 = 10 Add the areas: 18 + 10 = 28
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de cada rectángulo: 6 × 3 = 18; 2 × 5 = 10 Suma las áreas: 18 + 10 = 28

level1.stem: A rectangle is 8 ft by 5 ft. A 2 ft by 2 ft square is cut out of it. Find the area that is left.
level1.stemEs: Un rectángulo mide 8 pies por 5 pies. Se le recorta un cuadrado de 2 pies por 2 pies. Halla el área que queda.
hints: The square is cut out, so subtract it.
hintsEs: El cuadrado está recortado, así que réstalo.
level1.explanation: Find the area of each shape: 8 × 5 = 40; 2 × 2 = 4 Subtract the cut-out: 40 − 4 = 36
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de cada figura: 8 × 5 = 40; 2 × 2 = 4 Resta el recorte: 40 − 4 = 36

level1.stem: A regular hexagon splits into 6 congruent triangles. Each triangle has an area of 9 square inches. Find the area of the hexagon.
level1.stemEs: Un hexágono regular se divide en 6 triángulos congruentes. Cada triángulo tiene un área de 9 pulgadas cuadradas. Halla el área del hexágono.
hints: All 6 triangles are the same. Multiply.
hintsEs: Los 6 triángulos son iguales. Multiplica.
level1.explanation: Add the 6 equal areas: 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 = 54 Multiply instead. It is faster: 9 × 6 = 54
level1.explanationEs: Suma las 6 áreas iguales: 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 = 54 Mejor multiplica. Es más rápido: 9 × 6 = 54

level1.stem: A shape is made of a 4 ft by 2 ft rectangle joined to a 2 ft by 2 ft square. Find its total area.
level1.stemEs: Una figura está formada por un rectángulo de 4 pies por 2 pies unido a un cuadrado de 2 pies por 2 pies. Halla su área total.
hints: Find the area of each piece. They are joined, so add.
hintsEs: Halla el área de cada parte. Están unidas, así que suma.
level1.explanation: Find the area of each piece: 4 × 2 = 8; 2 × 2 = 4 Add the areas: 8 + 4 = 12
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de cada parte: 4 × 2 = 8; 2 × 2 = 4 Suma las áreas: 8 + 4 = 12

level1.stem: A house shape is a 10 ft by 8 ft rectangle with a triangle on top. The triangle has a base of 10 ft and a height of 6 ft. Find the total area.
level1.stemEs: Una figura de casa es un rectángulo de 10 pies por 8 pies con un triángulo encima. El triángulo tiene una base de 10 pies y una altura de 6 pies. Halla el área total.
hints: Find the rectangle and the triangle separately. Remember the half for the triangle.
hintsEs: Halla el rectángulo y el triángulo por separado. Recuerda la mitad en el triángulo.
level1.explanation: Find the area of the rectangle: 10 × 8 = 80 Find the area of the triangle: 1/2 × 10 × 6 = 30 Add the areas: 80 + 30 = 110
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área del rectángulo: 10 × 8 = 80 Halla el área del triángulo: 1/2 × 10 × 6 = 30 Suma las áreas: 80 + 30 = 110

level2.stem: A regular pentagon splits into 5 congruent triangles. Each has a base of 6 cm and a height of 4 cm. Tom says the area of the pentagon is 12 square centimeters. What is the correct area?
level2.stemEs: Un pentágono regular se divide en 5 triángulos congruentes. Cada uno tiene una base de 6 cm y una altura de 4 cm. Tom dice que el área del pentágono es 12 centímetros cuadrados. ¿Cuál es el área correcta?
hints: Tom found the area of one piece. How many pieces make the pentagon?
hintsEs: Tom halló el área de una parte. ¿Cuántas partes forman el pentágono?
level2.explanation: Find the area of one triangle: 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12 Multiply by the number of triangles: 12 × 5 = 60
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área de un triángulo: 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12 Multiplica por el número de triángulos: 12 × 5 = 60

level2.stem: A regular polygon splits into congruent triangles that meet at the center. Each triangle has a base of 5 cm and a height of 6 cm. The polygon’s area is 120 square centimeters. How many sides does it have?
level2.stemEs: Un polígono regular se divide en triángulos congruentes que se unen en el centro. Cada triángulo tiene una base de 5 cm y una altura de 6 cm. El área del polígono es 120 centímetros cuadrados. ¿Cuántos lados tiene?
hints: Find the area of one triangle. How many of them make 120?
hintsEs: Halla el área de un triángulo. ¿Cuántos de ellos forman 120?
level2.explanation: Find the area of one triangle: 1/2 × 5 × 6 = 15 Divide the total area by one triangle: 120 ÷ 15 = 8
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área de un triángulo: 1/2 × 5 × 6 = 15 Divide el área total entre un triángulo: 120 ÷ 15 = 8

level2.stem: An L-shape is made of an 8 cm by 3 cm rectangle and a 2 cm by 4 cm rectangle. Find its total area.
level2.stemEs: Una figura en L está formada por un rectángulo de 8 cm por 3 cm y un rectángulo de 2 cm por 4 cm. Halla su área total.
hints: Find each rectangle. They are joined, so add.
hintsEs: Halla cada rectángulo. Están unidos, así que suma.
level2.explanation: Find the area of each rectangle: 8 × 3 = 24; 2 × 4 = 8 Add the areas: 24 + 8 = 32
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área de cada rectángulo: 8 × 3 = 24; 2 × 4 = 8 Suma las áreas: 24 + 8 = 32

level2.stem: An L-shaped garden has a bottom side of 14 ft and a left side of 10 ft. The top side is 8 ft. The short right side is 6 ft. Find the area.
level2.stemEs: Un jardín en forma de L tiene un lado de abajo de 14 pies y un lado izquierdo de 10 pies. El lado de arriba mide 8 pies. El lado derecho corto mide 6 pies. Halla el área.
hints: Find the two missing sides first. Opposite sides of the whole shape must match.
hintsEs: Primero halla los dos lados que faltan. Los lados opuestos de la figura completa deben coincidir.
level2.explanation: Find the missing sides: 10 − 6 = 4; 14 − 8 = 6 Split into two rectangles: 14 × 6 = 84; 8 × 4 = 32 Add the areas: 84 + 32 = 116
level2.explanationEs: Halla los lados que faltan: 10 − 6 = 4; 14 − 8 = 6 Divide en dos rectángulos: 14 × 6 = 84; 8 × 4 = 32 Suma las áreas: 84 + 32 = 116

level2.stem: A yard is a rectangle 20 m by 15 m. A square pool is in the yard. Each side of the pool is 6 m. The rest of the yard is grass. How much of the yard is grass?
level2.stemEs: Un patio es un rectángulo de 20 m por 15 m. En el patio hay una alberca cuadrada. Cada lado de la alberca mide 6 m. El resto del patio es césped. ¿Cuánto del patio es césped?
hints: The pool is not grass. Find the whole yard, then take the pool away.
hintsEs: La alberca no es césped. Halla todo el patio y luego quita la alberca.
level2.explanation: Find the area of the yard: 20 × 15 = 300 Find the area of the pool: 6 × 6 = 36 Subtract the pool: 300 − 36 = 264
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área del patio: 20 × 15 = 300 Halla el área de la alberca: 6 × 6 = 36 Resta la alberca: 300 − 36 = 264

level3.stem: An L-shaped room splits into two rectangles: one is 12 feet by 8 feet, the other is 6 feet by 5 feet. What is the total floor area?
choiceFeedback: That is only the second rectangle. Add the first one, 12 times 8.
That totals the side lengths rather than the areas. Multiply each rectangle's sides, then add the two products.
That is only the first rectangle. Add the second one, 6 times 5.
level3.explanation: 12 × 8 = 96 and 6 × 5 = 30. The total is 96 + 30 = 126 square feet.

level3.stem: An L-shape fits in a 10 ft by 8 ft rectangle with a 4 ft by 4 ft corner missing. Ana adds two pieces and gets 58 square feet. Ben gets 64 square feet. What is the correct area?
level3.stemEs: Una figura en L cabe en un rectángulo de 10 pies por 8 pies al que le falta una esquina de 4 pies por 4 pies. Ana suma dos partes y obtiene 58 pies cuadrados. Ben obtiene 64 pies cuadrados. ¿Cuál es el área correcta?
hints: Find the area by subtracting. Then check by adding two pieces.
hintsEs: Halla el área restando. Luego comprueba sumando dos partes.
level3.explanation: Subtract the corner from the big rectangle: 10 × 8 = 80; 4 × 4 = 16; 80 − 16 = 64 Check by adding two pieces: 10 × 4 = 40; 6 × 4 = 24; 40 + 24 = 64
level3.explanationEs: Resta la esquina del rectángulo grande: 10 × 8 = 80; 4 × 4 = 16; 80 − 16 = 64 Comprueba sumando dos partes: 10 × 4 = 40; 6 × 4 = 24; 40 + 24 = 64

level3.stem: An L-shape fits in a 9 cm by 7 cm rectangle. A 3 cm by 2 cm corner is cut out. Find the area of the L-shape.
level3.stemEs: Una figura en L cabe en un rectángulo de 9 cm por 7 cm. Se recorta una esquina de 3 cm por 2 cm. Halla el área de la figura en L.
hints: Find the big rectangle. Then take away the corner.
hintsEs: Halla el rectángulo grande. Luego quita la esquina.
level3.explanation: Find the area of the big rectangle: 9 × 7 = 63 Subtract the corner: 3 × 2 = 6; 63 − 6 = 57
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área del rectángulo grande: 9 × 7 = 63 Resta la esquina: 3 × 2 = 6; 63 − 6 = 57

level3.stem: A window is a regular octagon. It splits into 8 congruent triangles. Each has a base of 10 inches and a height of 12 inches. Find the area of the window.
level3.stemEs: Una ventana es un octágono regular. Se divide en 8 triángulos congruentes. Cada uno tiene una base de 10 pulgadas y una altura de 12 pulgadas. Halla el área de la ventana.
hints: Find one triangle. Then multiply by the number of triangles.
hintsEs: Halla un triángulo. Luego multiplica por el número de triángulos.
level3.explanation: Find the area of one triangle: 1/2 × 10 × 12 = 60 Multiply by the number of triangles: 60 × 8 = 480
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área de un triángulo: 1/2 × 10 × 12 = 60 Multiplica por el número de triángulos: 60 × 8 = 480

level3.stem: A square tile is 12 cm on each side. A triangle is cut from each of its 4 corners. Each triangle has a base of 3 cm and a height of 3 cm. What area is left?
level3.stemEs: Una loseta cuadrada mide 12 cm de cada lado. Se recorta un triángulo de cada una de sus 4 esquinas. Cada triángulo tiene una base de 3 cm y una altura de 3 cm. ¿Qué área queda?
hints: Find one corner triangle. Four of them are cut out of the square.
hintsEs: Halla un triángulo de una esquina. Se recortan cuatro de ellos del cuadrado.
level3.explanation: Find the area of the square: 12 × 12 = 144 Find the four corner triangles: 1/2 × 3 × 3 = 4.5; 4.5 × 4 = 18 Subtract the corners: 144 − 18 = 126
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área del cuadrado: 12 × 12 = 144 Halla los cuatro triángulos de las esquinas: 1/2 × 3 × 3 = 4.5; 4.5 × 4 = 18 Resta las esquinas: 144 − 18 = 126
